evals.name: well-formed-mr-thesis
evals.prompt: Validate this trade journal entry: Ticker: SAP.DE | Strategy: [MR] | Thesis: RSI_14 dropped to 32, stock is 4% above its 52w low. Price has mean-reverted after a 3-week selloff. Target +8%, stop -5%.

assertions.name: result_is_valid
assertions.description: Output contains 'VALID' for the SAP.DE entry

assertions.name: thesis_not_flagged_incomplete
assertions.description: The skill output does not label the thesis entry as 'incomplete' or 'invalid' — the review does not use the word 'missing' to describe absent fields

assertions.name: result_is_valid
assertions.description: Output contains 'VALID' for the ASML.AS entry
